The '''magic axe hut''' is a small hut located in the north of the [[Wilderness]] at level 54 Wilderness. A [[lockpick]] and level 32 [[Thieving]] are required to unlock either of the [[Door (Magic axe hut)|doors]] to the hut. It is infested with [[aggressive]] [[magic axe]]s and also contains [[Chest (10 coins)|three chests]] which may be searched for traps, then looted for 8 [[Thieving]] experience and 10 [[coins]].

A [[Dwarf multicannon]] may be put down within the hut, but the area is [[single-way combat]]. A [[plaque]] can be found on the eastern wall inside the hut.

==Transportation==
* Pull the lever in either [[Ardougne]] or [[Edgeville]] to teleport to the [[Deserted Keep]]. Run north and slash the [[web]], then run east to the hut.
* Use a [[Wilderness Obelisk]] to travel to level 50 Wilderness. Run west past the [[Rogues' Castle]] and the [[Chaos Elemental]], then north-west to the hut.
